description: Create a new Cloud DB for MongoDB instance. Backups are always on (only the retention period and time can be set). Use dryRun=true to preview without creating.

backupFileRetentionPeriod.description: Backup retention period in days (1-30, default 1)

backupTime.description: Backup start time HH:mm in 15-minute steps (default 02:00)

cloudMongoDbServerNamePrefix.description: Server name prefix (3-15 chars: lowercase letters, numbers, hyphen; starts with a letter). A random suffix is appended

cloudMongoDbServiceName.description: MongoDB service name (3-15 chars: lowercase letters, numbers, hyphen). Unique; becomes the replica set name

configServerCount.description: Number of config servers (for sharded cluster)

dataStorageTypeCode.description: Data storage type: SSD | HDD (G2 images, default SSD); CB2 for G3 images (public zone only). Available types depend on the zone — check ncloud_get_mongodb_products

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating the instance

engineVersionCode.description: MongoDB engine version code. Several versions share one image product code, so set this to pick a version (latest if omitted)

memberServerCount.description: Number of member servers in the replica set

mongosServerCount.description: Number of mongos servers (for sharded cluster)

shardCount.description: Number of shards (2-3, default 2; SHARDED_CLUSTER only)

name: ncloud_create_mongodb_instance
